# fabric_onelake_diagnostic_setting (Data Source)

The OneLake Diagnostic Setting data-source allows you to retrieve details about a Fabric [OneLake Diagnostic Setting](https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/fabric/core/onelake-settings/modify-diagnostics).

-> This data-source supports Service Principal authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fabric_onelake_diagnostic_setting" "example" {
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The ID of the source Workspace. The caller must have an Admin role on this Workspace.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `destination` (Attributes) The destination where OneLake diagnostic logs are stored. Required when diagnostics are enabled. When diagnostics are disabled, include the destination to retain it or omit it to clear it. The destination Lakehouse must be in the same capacity as the source Workspace, and the caller must have a Contributor or higher role on the destination Workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination))
- `status` (String) The status of OneLake diagnostic logging. Possible values: `Enabled`, `Disabled`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

<a id="nestedatt--destination"></a>

### Nested Schema for `destination`

Read-Only:

- `lakehouse` (Attributes) The Lakehouse receiving OneLake diagnostic logs. The API currently supports references by ID only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination--lakehouse))

<a id="nestedatt--destination--lakehouse"></a>

### Nested Schema for `destination.lakehouse`

Read-Only:

- `item_id` (String) The ID of the destination Lakehouse.
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID of the Workspace containing the destination Lakehouse.
